summary: Steep street with houses 4-12 m from the kerb nearly all the way.
reasons: Steep: about 11% at the best gap
Narrow street with hedges and fences

best_section.where: east kerb of Manchester Terrace, midway up the hill between two houses

drivers.seclusion: Houses 10-21 m from this gap and 8-12 m at either side; homes front the whole east side.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street; cars park on the opposite side, little clear ground beside this kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Residents park on the west side; no sign of overnight vans.

flags: Steep: about 11% here, 18% max along the stretch
Mapped dwellings 4-12 m from kerb along most of the length
sun_shade: Hedges and trees shade the east kerb from the east; open to the west.
